# StickyNotes.club Help Centre

> Official user documentation for StickyNotes.club, a web application for running workshops, developing ideas on private boards and sharing individual ideas publicly.

The Help Centre describes implemented StickyNotes.club behaviour in plain English. Use these pages to answer questions about accounts, Public sticky notes, private boards, collaboration, workshops, plans, privacy, safety and support. Capitalised product terms such as Draft, Public, Owner, Participant, View link, Post link and workshop link have specific meanings in the documentation.

## Start here

- [How can we help?](https://docs.stickynotes.club/): Overview of the available guides and support topics.
- [Run a workshop](https://docs.stickynotes.club/run-a-workshop/): Prepare and guide a session, make decisions, finish with read-only results, export them as PDF, Markdown or CSV and reuse the clean setup.
- [Take part in a workshop](https://docs.stickynotes.club/join-a-workshop/): Join with a link or QR code, contribute without an account and open the finished result.
- [Get started with StickyNotes.club](https://docs.stickynotes.club/getting-started/): Create an account, understand when email confirmation is required and choose where a first idea belongs.
- [Find a quick answer](https://docs.stickynotes.club/faq/): Short answers about accounts, content, sharing, invitations and plans.

## Run a session

- [Choose a session format](https://docs.stickynotes.club/choose-a-session-format/): Compare the session formats a workshop board can start from, see what each one fills in and adjust the run sheet.
- [Run your first retrospective](https://docs.stickynotes.club/run-your-first-retrospective/): A step-by-step walkthrough of one retrospective, from preparing the board to sharing the result.
- [Run a feedback session](https://docs.stickynotes.club/run-a-feedback-session/): Run an anonymous feedback session, read the room's input and turn it into decisions and action items.
- [Live collaboration](https://docs.stickynotes.club/live-collaboration/): See private-board changes live, understand autosave and recover safely from conflicts or connection problems.

## Build on a board

- [Create and manage a private board](https://docs.stickynotes.club/private-boards/): Create, manage and duplicate private-board setups, control access and understand permanent board deletion.
- [Work together on a board](https://docs.stickynotes.club/collaboration/): Invite Participants, share board links and use collaborative features.
- [Organise your work](https://docs.stickynotes.club/organise-your-work/): Use layouts, colours, tags and due dates on private boards.
- [Keep a board going](https://docs.stickynotes.club/keep-a-board-going/): Keep a Kanban board or week planner readable and useful over time.

## Share ideas and manage your account

- [Create and share a sticky note](https://docs.stickynotes.club/sticky-notes/): Create, publish, share, edit and delete sticky notes and Instant Photos.
- [Manage your profile and account](https://docs.stickynotes.club/manage-your-profile/): Update profile and security details and understand account deletion.
- [Choose and manage your plan](https://docs.stickynotes.club/plans-and-subscriptions/): Compare Club Member, Club Host, Club Facilitator and Chosen Few and understand plan limits.

## Privacy, safety and support

- [Understand privacy and stay safe](https://docs.stickynotes.club/privacy-and-safety/): Understand content visibility, ownership, external indexing and account safety.
- [Help keep StickyNotes.club welcoming](https://docs.stickynotes.club/community-guidelines/): Rules for respectful, lawful and safe participation.
- [Solve a problem](https://docs.stickynotes.club/troubleshooting/): Resolve common sign-in, invitation, publication, upload and saving problems.
- [Contact support](https://docs.stickynotes.club/contact-and-support/): Ask for help, report a bug or concern, make a privacy request or share feedback.

## Optional

- [StickyNotes.club](https://stickynotes.club/): Open the web application.
- [Privacy Policy](https://stickynotes.club/privacy/): Legal information about personal data and privacy.
- [Terms of Service](https://stickynotes.club/terms): Rules and conditions governing use of the service.
